description:
Flight planning software for pilots.

SkyDemon Plan provides flight-planning features for pilots on Windows.
- The Rainfall weather overlay has increased spatial resolution and better colours (iOS, Android, PC)
- Flyable Conditions is now updated every 10 minutes (iOS, Android, PC)
  Previously, the data was updated every 15 minutes.
- Rainfall is now incorporated into Flyable Conditions (iOS, Android, PC)
  Previously, forecast rainfall would not have an effect on the flyable forecast. Now, heavy rain will cause yellow and red areas.
